title: Massive; hollow
text: Massive; hollow. When I initially saw these, I thought it would be more of like a vintage piece from my grandma‘s era. It’s not, it definitely has a made in China appearance to it. The pieces themselves are very very tall. The candle holder plate is tilted, so all your wax will drip off. The pieces are hollow, so they’re not very heavy. And the paint looks like fake brass or fake gold. I was pretty disappointed. They won’t fit in a bookshelf for a small little while recess, I don’t know where to put them now.
